subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 263 (CMBA-19). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names PRIN-INFO; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), INT (intention) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INT: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) and CN-INFO (controlled information). From SOC-RT-DY: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) and CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CN-INFO: AF-COMP (affinity compression). From IST-F-AT: INTR (interpretation). From CULT-AF-BS: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: AF-COMP-2 (affinity compression).
